name: Notion backlog
description: Use Notion as the backlog, one agent iteration at a time

backlogName.message: What is your backlog called in Notion?
backlogName.why: Named in the rules so the agent speaks of your backlog by name.

backlogUrl.why: Open the page in Notion and copy the address bar.

dataSourceUri.message: Data source URI of the backlog
dataSourceUri.why: What the agent queries to find your tickets — a URL is not enough for that.
dataSourceUri.whenUnsure: Leave it empty: tick « Create the Notion database » and this is one of the things it hands back. On an existing backlog, tools/get_data_source_id.py prints it.

ticketPrefix.message: Two to four letters to number your tickets with
ticketPrefix.why: Ticket DHA-12 becomes branch feature/dha-12-…, so it stays short.

ticketPageUrl.message: Link to your "Writing a ticket" page
ticketPageUrl.why: How a ticket is written lives in Notion, not in the skill — the agent reads it before writing one.
ticketPageUrl.whenUnsure: Tick the « Writing a ticket » page component instead: the wizard writes that page and fills this in.

mainBranch.message: Which branch should pull requests target?
mainBranch.why: Every iteration branches off it and opens its pull request against it.
mainBranch.whenUnsure: The suggestion is read from this repository — keep it.

localChecks.message: Commands that must pass before a push
localChecks.why: Seeds .claude/rules/checks.md. Never asked: read from your build file when there is one, and left for the project to record when there is not.

coverageCmd.why: Seeds .claude/rules/checks.md, like the checks above, and stays empty until the project has one.

repoLang.message: Which language do you want written in the repository?
repoLang.why: Commit messages, pull requests, comments and documentation — not the programming language, that one the code decides.

chatLang.message: Which language should the agent talk to you in?
chatLang.why: Chat, Notion tickets and the reports it writes on them.

notionToken.why: Used for this one call, then forgotten — it is never written to a file.
notionToken.whenUnsure: notion.so/my-integrations → New integration, then share your parent page with it.

notionParentPage.message: Link to the Notion page the backlog should go under
notionParentPage.why: A database is created inside a page, and that page must be shared with your integration.

projectName.why: Heads the Claude Project instructions this writes.

projectPitch.message: In one line, what is this project for?
projectPitch.why: The opening line of the Claude Project instructions.
projectPitch.whenUnsure: A rough sentence is enough — the framing tickets are what turn it into needs, and they will say it better than today.
projectPitch.example: Dharma is a field station network for behavioural research
